overview: Dr. Rajasekaran (RAJA) Namakkal-Soorappan, a Tenured Associate Professor at the University of Alabama at Birmingham (UAB), holds degrees in Biology and Biochemistry (University of Madras, Tamil Nadu, India). Having undergone extensive post-doctoral training at the Indian Institute of Technology Madras (IIT-M, Tamil Nadu, India) and the University of Utah (Salt Lake City, USA), he specializes in understanding the redox mechanisms for proteotoxic cardiac and brain diseases. His research, supported by grants from organizations like the American Heart Association (AHA) and the National Institutes of Health (NIH), focuses on the molecular mechanisms of reductive stress (RS). Dr. Namakkal-Soorappan is a leading figure in the field of RS, collaborating with global experts to define the causes and consequences of RS mechanisms in human diseases. Additionally, he actively engages in social awareness activities promoting exercise for cardiac health and is an author of novels, poetry, and screenplays for Tamil movies and short films.
